seo.title: 13 Best Ramen in Shinjuku (2026) — Reddit-Backed Guide | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: The best ramen shops in Shinjuku, Tokyo — curated from hundreds of Reddit recommendations. Tsukemen, tonkotsu, niboshi, shio & more. Interactive map included.

hero.subtitle: From rich tonkotsu to delicate clam shio, these are the ramen shops that Tokyo locals and Reddit travelers actually recommend — not the tourist traps with hour-long queues.

methodology: We analyzed 200+ Reddit posts and 1,000+ comments across r/ramen, r/JapanTravel, r/TokyoTravel, and r/Tokyo — spanning 2019 to 2026. Shops were ranked by frequency of independent recommendations (not just one viral post). Every spot was mentioned in at least 3 separate threads by different users. Google ratings, review counts, and recency were cross-referenced.
